label: positive

blockers.detail: harness calls png_read_update_info() and then png_start_read_image(); in libpng 1.6 the second row-initialisation is a 'duplicate call' png_app_error, which (APP_ERRORS_WARN not set) is png_error -> longjmp to the harness cleanup, so no row is ever read

evidence: da923d334 (2017-08-26) added png_read_update_info() to the harness while keeping png_start_read_image()
maintainer fix f648294931 (2017-10-13): 'Removed call to png_read_start_image() from the fuzzer. In libpng16 it is an error to call that along with png_read_update_info().'

the fix is applied as the maintainer's own one-line hunk ported onto the harness at M (verification/counterfactual_fix.diff holds that port); the harness at H also carries unrelated additions (png_set_* transforms), which are not used
rationale_zh: 本次提交只在 pngrutil.c 的 png_read_buffer() 中加了一个 memset，该函数位于逐行读取 IDAT 的路径上（png_read_IDAT_data 调用它）。但自 2017-08-26 起 harness 先调用 png_read_update_info()，随后又调用 png_start_read_image()：在 libpng 1.6 中两者都会做行初始化，第二次调用被判定为“duplicate call”的 png_app_error，未设置 APP_ERRORS_WARN 时即为 png_error，经 longjmp 跳回 harness 的清理分支。于是每个输入在读第一行之前就结束：png_read_row、png_read_IDAT_data、各种 filter/interlace 解码路径覆盖恒为 0，harness 却照常运行、不报错。这是初始化调用顺序（生命周期）契约被违反导致的隐式退化，早于本次 diff；维护者在 f648294931 删除了多余的 png_start_read_image() 调用。
rationale_en: This commit only adds a memset() to png_read_buffer() in pngrutil.c, a function on the row-reading path (png_read_IDAT_data calls it). Since 2017-08-26, however, the harness calls png_read_update_info() and then png_start_read_image(): in libpng 1.6 both perform row initialisation, the second one is a 'duplicate call' png_app_error, and without APP_ERRORS_WARN that is png_error, which longjmps to the harness cleanup. Every input therefore ends before the first row is read: png_read_row, png_read_IDAT_data and all filter/interlace decoding paths keep zero coverage while the harness runs without any visible error. A silent degradation caused by violating the initialisation call-order (lifecycle) contract, predating this diff; fixed by the maintainer in f648294931, which removes the redundant png_start_read_image() call.
